description: The pipeline reads your conversations once and feeds its plugins (usage stats and deep search). Both are built in and always on, so nothing asks you to approve a data view, a grant, a start point or a slow lane, and Settings has no switch, pause, grant or backfill screen for them. Settings, pipeline shows one read-only status line (caught up, behind with a file count and a lag, stalled since a time, or rebuilding a plugin) and, under it, one row per plugin with how much waits for it and a rebuild button (it asks first, because it replaces that plugin's data). The same status and rebuild are available over the API.
how_to: read the status line at the top: caught up, behind, stalled or rebuilding.
use rebuild on a plugin's row to start its data over; it asks first, because it replaces that plugin's data.
media_exempt: the screen's captures are recaptured from features/capture before the next version bump; rendering was checked under three themes
name: Pipeline plugins
summary: one status line for the pipeline and a rebuild button per plugin; the approval screens (data views, grants, start points, slow lane) are gone.
